# [CS046] Blocking Call Inside a Database Transaction (tx-network-io)

An HTTP, gRPC or network call, or a sleep, happens while a transaction is open.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | HIGH |
| **Category** | Reliability & Concurrency |
| **CWE** | [CWE-400](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/400.html) |
| **OWASP** | A06:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

A transaction holds a pooled connection and row locks until it ends. Calling a slow external service inside it keeps both for the duration of that call, so a degraded dependency exhausts the pool and blocks other writers. The analysis follows calls through up to eight project functions, including interface calls resolved by the call graph, and reports the chain. Calls started with go are not part of the transaction.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
tx, err := db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
if err != nil {
	return err
}
defer tx.Rollback()
if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, "UPDATE orders SET status = 'paid' WHERE id = $1", id); err != nil {
	return err
}
if err := payments.Charge(ctx, id); err != nil { // HTTP call while the row is locked
	return err
}
return tx.Commit()
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
if err := payments.Charge(ctx, id); err != nil {
	return err
}
tx, err := db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
if err != nil {
	return err
}
defer tx.Rollback()
if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, "UPDATE orders SET status = 'paid' WHERE id = $1", id); err != nil {
	return err
}
return tx.Commit()
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [tx-network-io]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    tx-network-io: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore tx-network-io -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** tx-network-io
```
